column2: Write a "Working With Me" document I can send to new clients before a project starts. My business: [describe]. Typical project: [describe]. Include: (1) How I communicate (preferred channels, response times, office hours), (2) What I need from you (the client) to do my best work — turnaround times on feedback, access to tools, single point of contact, etc., (3) My process — how a typical project flows from kickoff to delivery, (4) What's included vs. out of scope, (5) How revisions work — [number] rounds included, how to request, (6) Payment terms — when invoices go out, when payment is due, late fees if applicable, (7) How to give feedback (be specific, reference examples, consolidate into one round). Tone: professional but not stiff. This should prevent 90% of client headaches.

Write a step-by-step hiring SOP for my [type of business]. We typically hire [types of roles — e.g., freelance writers, virtual assistants, junior developers]. Our hiring process should include: (1) How to define the role and write the job description, (2) Where to post the job (suggest specific platforms for [my role types]), (3) How to screen applications (what to look for, red flags), (4) Interview process (how many rounds, who's involved, what to assess in each), (5) How to evaluate candidates (scoring criteria), (6) How to make an offer, (7) What to do when someone declines. Include timelines (how long each step should take) and templates/checklists where applicable. This is for a small team — no HR department. Keep it lean.

I need to optimize how I work. Here's my current workflow for [describe your core business process — e.g., "getting a new client from first contact to paid invoice" or "creating and publishing content weekly"]:
[Describe your current step-by-step process, including tools, time spent, and pain points]
Audit my workflow for: (1) Bottlenecks — where is time being wasted? (2) Redundancies — what am I doing twice that I could do once? (3) Automation opportunities — what steps could be automated and with what tools? (4) Delegation opportunities — what should I NOT be doing myself? (5) Tool consolidation — am I using 3 tools where 1 would do? (6) Batch processing — what could I batch instead of doing ad-hoc? Give me a redesigned workflow with estimated time savings. Be specific — name tools, suggest automations, estimate hours saved per week.
